login.title: Sign in to labhq
login.lead: Use the passkey you enrolled on this address. Your device asks for your fingerprint, face or PIN.
login.not_enrolled: No passkey is enrolled yet. Run this on the machine labhq runs on, then open the link it prints:

enroll.title: Create a passkey
enroll.lead: This passkey works on this address only. Your device asks for your fingerprint, face or PIN.
enroll.done: Passkey created. Sign in to continue.
enroll.no_token: This page needs an enrollment link. Run `labhq passkey enroll` on the machine labhq runs on.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.add_title: Add a passkey on another device
passkeys.add_lead: Scan the code with your phone to enroll a passkey on your public address. The link works once and expires soon.
passkeys.add_button: Show a link and QR code
passkeys.qr_alt: QR code for the enrollment link
passkeys.failed: That did not work. Check that LABHQ_PUBLIC_URL is set, then try again.

errors.cancelled: The passkey prompt was dismissed or timed out. Try again.
errors.unsupported: This browser cannot use passkeys. Use a current browser over https or on localhost.
errors.no_passkey: No passkey is enrolled for this address. A passkey works only on the address it was made on.
errors.enrollment_link_invalid: This enrollment link was already used, has expired or belongs to another address. Create a new one.
errors.origin_not_allowed: labhq does not accept sign-in from this address. Set LABHQ_PUBLIC_URL to it.
errors.rejected: The passkey was not accepted. Try again.
errors.network: labhq cannot be reached. Check that it is running.
